Question 4
?

Write the following first-order linear ODE in standard form. 2dydx−3cos⁡x=1−4ysin⁡x

a
dydx+(2sin⁡x)y=1+32cos⁡x
b
dydx+(2sin⁡x)y=1+3cos⁡x2
c
dydx+(4sin⁡x)y=1+3cos⁡x
d
dydx+1+3cos⁡x2=(2sin⁡x)y
e
dydx+(4cos⁡x)y=1+3sin⁡x
